title: Google Documents
slide_intent: Teach staff how to maintain a readable hierarchy on computers that lack the brand typeface. A shared document must remain usable for its next editor.
strategic_value: CSAIL can give internal documents and email a practical typographic convention using widely available fonts.
demonstration: A laptop screen shows Arial Regular and Italic followed by Georgia Regular and Italic. The guidance allows Arial for internal uses and recommends Georgia for long text.
practical_value: Choose Arial for routine shared documents or email, and consider Georgia for extended reading.

content_islands.name: Fallback guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the Google Documents title and the Arial and Georgia recommendations in the left rail.

content_islands.name: Screen specimen
content_islands.spec: Crop the laptop into the large pale field on the right. Stack four labeled sample rows, grouping the two Arial styles above the two Georgia styles.
